---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for dreamy
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that dreamy doesn't currently support? Describe
the real workflow, not just the feature — this helps evaluate whether an
existing subcommand or flag already covers it.

## Proposed solution

What would you like dreamy to do instead? If you have a specific CLI
shape in mind (new subcommand, new flag, new output format), describe it.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're currently using, or other approaches you considered
and rejected, and why.

## Scope

- Does this touch a specific connector (claude / codex / omp / opencode /
  pi / nine_router), or is it cross-cutting?
- Would this change dreamy's read-only guarantee, its redaction behavior,
  or what leaves the machine in a bundle? (See `SECURITY.md` — changes
  here get extra scrutiny.)

## Additional context

Anything else — links, examples from other tools, etc.
